stories.headline: Anthropic Reveals *New Models* Before IPO
stories.facts: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, which solve open physics problems and write over 90 percent of core code.
stories.caption_line: 🚀 Anthropic drops powerful new models right before its massive public offering.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage featuring glowing neural networks in the foreground, with futuristic server architecture in the midground. Holographic data streams and rising performance charts float across the scene. Dramatic studio rim lighting with an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO *Investigation* Shakes AI Industry
stories.facts: Nvidia's board opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following an extramarital relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.
stories.caption_line: ⚠️ Nvidia faces intense scrutiny as an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang unfolds.
stories.image_prompt: A confident corporate portrait in the foreground with a sleek tech headquarters and glowing data nodes in the midground. Floating holographic compliance metrics and warning UI panels overlay the scene. Professional studio lighting with a striking electric-blue and warm-orange palette.
stories.source_title: Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling

stories.headline: Google Expands *TPU Family* To Challenge Competitors
stories.facts: Google shipped four TPU variants in one year, introducing the TPU 8tx for encrypted data and the TPU 8i Max for doubled compute power.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Google ramps up the hardware race by expanding its custom TPU chip lineup.
stories.image_prompt: An intricate semiconductor microchip hero subject in the foreground, with advanced server racks and automated factory assembly lines in the midground. Glowing circuit pathways and rising performance metrics hover as holographic overlays. High-tech blue and warm amber lighting palette.
stories.source_title: Google ships four TPU variants in one year as it ramps up competition with Nvidia

stories.headline: Meta Launches *Muse Ember* For Agent Tasks
stories.facts: Meta introduced Muse Ember, a small and efficient model optimized for repetitive agent workflows like tool calls and data extraction.
stories.caption_line: 🤖 Meta introduces a lightweight model built specifically to power efficient AI agents.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing miniature robotic core in the foreground, set against a modern developer workspace in the midground. Holographic lines of code and efficiency charts stream through the air. Vibrant electric-blue and warm-orange glow with dramatic studio lighting.
stories.source_title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do

stories.headline: Disney Partners With *Adobe* For Custom AI
stories.facts: Disney teamed up with Adobe to develop proprietary generative AI models supporting productions across theme parks, cruises, and films.
stories.caption_line: 🎨 Disney teams up with Adobe to build brand-safe generative AI production tools.
stories.image_prompt: A high-end digital drawing tablet displaying creative art in the foreground, with a bustling animation studio and cinematic production lights in the midground. Floating holographic color palettes and AI generation grids overlay the view. Warm-orange and cool-blue cinematic lighting.
stories.source_title: Disney and Adobe are building generative AI tools together

stories.headline: ByteDance Drops *Seedream* For Stable Editing
stories.facts: ByteDance introduced Seedream 5.5, an image model supporting stable multi-pass editing across up to 100 iterations without color drift.
stories.caption_line: ✨ ByteDance releases a new image generation model built for professional editing workflows.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek digital canvas displaying layered graphics in the foreground, with a modern design studio in the midground. Holographic iteration counters and multi-pass UI elements float in the air. Clean studio lighting with vibrant electric-blue and warm-orange tones.
stories.source_title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift

stories.headline: Nvidia Brings *Open Models* To Production
stories.facts: Nvidia released Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for leading Korean open models to help scale requests across multiple GPUs.
stories.caption_line: 🌐 Nvidia expands global deployment infrastructure for leading international open-source models.
stories.image_prompt: A high-performance computing cluster module in the foreground, with an advanced manufacturing assembly plant in the midground. Holographic cluster maps and data flow schematics overlay the scene. Electric-blue and warm-orange lighting palette.
stories.source_title: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production
